notes: Each of 40 cases judged by an isolated Claude (Opus 4.8) subagent seeing only that case dossier + the fixed SYSTEM_PROMPT. Deterministic preprocessing extracted shared-file hunks and cross-symbol signals per pair; AI made the label decision. totalLatencyMs is batch wall-clock (span of prediction-file write times across concurrency-capped waves). Per-subagent token counts were emitted by the harness but not aggregated by the wrapper, so totals are null.
